name: MODEL838MK2
description:
## Description

"A preamplifier developed exclusively for analog records.The 838mk2is designed to transfer the output signal through an independent passive circuit when connected to a power amplifier, so that line-level music playback operations are not affected even when the power supply is turned off. This not only eliminates the convenience of requiring no connection changes, but also eliminates the effect of degraded signals from other preamps on the phono stage.It is also possible to use MM/MC preferred cartridges by adding 838mk2.Only for MC or MM type. Two types of cartridges cannot be connected at the same time.The standard input terminal is an unbalanced type, and the balanced type is optional.Six pairs of adapter plugs are included as standard to optimize the impedance of the cartridge and preamplifier.The impedance range is from 3to 1,000�.Equipped with a DIP switch with eight different sensitivity settings, the input sensitivity can be adjusted, which is important for optimum S/N ratio and over-load margin. This improves the S/N ratio and protects the cartridge from over-loading.By setting the linear stage before RIAA equalization, the dynamic range which stands out in the high frequency region is obtained.By preserving the minimum HF signal even after the equalization process, the sound quality is transparent, stretchy and high-pitched sound, and three dimensional and stable stereo images are reproduced.The RIAA deviation is less than 1% of the characteristic curve in the 30hz to 20khz band.The hum noise is at least 20dB below the noise level typical of analog records, and the distortion is less than the measurement limit.It is a dual monaural design including the transformer in the independent power supply box, and there is no intermodulation between each channel.A step-type attenuator type level controller using a low-capacity register and an effective range doubling independent switch is adopted.The power amplier or active speaker can be remotely turned on / off by the DC signal of the independent power box."

name: MODEL878
description:
## Description

"A stereo power amplifier that pursues balance theory.The Model878supports balanced connections and provides better reproducibility than conventional unbalanced connections.The interior is completely independent on the left and right.By replacing the plug-in type circuit board, you can use it in three different ways : stereo amplifier, monaural amplifier, or active speaker.When using a stereo amplifier, the two monaural amplifiers in the main unit amplify each of the L and R channels. When using a monaural power amplifier, a bridge connection allows two monaural amplifiers to be driven in one block for high power output.The active speaker configuration uses an optional crossover module (sold separately).A crossover circuit board allows you to switch between two monaural amplifiers, one with an integrated high-pass filter and the other with an integrated low-pass filter. The circuit board has a 6dB per octave attenuation and allows you to specify the crossover frequency."

name: 911MK3
description:
## Description

"This is the third generation of the Stereo Power Amplifier 911, which was born in 1990.In particular, the output stage of 911mk3has been greatly enhanced.A four parallel-connected output stage consisting of eight carefully selected pair transistors is driven by a power supply consisting of a filter capacitor with a total capacity of 130,000Ï‰ F and a huge toroidal transformer with a total capacity of 750VA to achieve a high output.The circuit design is a fully balanced transmission and pure DC coupling that does not incorporate a capacitor in the signal path, eliminating the effect on sound quality.Uses a full modular design.It is also possible to make monaural configuration by bridge connection.Bridge connection is performed by external adapter or factory internal setting.Uses Burgess traditional balanced circuit design.The input stage is designed using a Class A operation X amplifier unique to Blumester.The overall NFB is kept very small.A high damping factor of approximately 3000controls the speakers in all bands.Silver cables unique to Burgundy are used for internal wiring.Power ON/OFF can be controlled remotely in combination with preamp 808mk5.Built-in protection circuit for overheating and DC offset.Equipped with chrome-plated bracket.The chassis is made of silver anodized aluminum."
